INDEPENDENCE_LIMITATION = Owner executed separate probes but saw specification and author results and authored fixture erratum; not blind or external-panel independence. No Owner real child or full-suite rerun.

CODEX_REVIEW = PRIMARY_OWNER_TARGETED_SOURCE_AND_COUNTEREXAMPLE_REVIEW; no helper model or delegated reviewer called

The stale-file/contradictory-proof/startup-handle rejection routes were not reproduced on the repaired APIs: genuine controls pass and 35 observations match. The focused-run stream caveat remains supported and prevents an unqualified all-runs-clean claim. It does not invalidate the clean same-freeze FINAL/capture evidence. Safe reuse is only for this engineering host mechanism, never accepted source authority, actual R0 PASS or R1 admission. Full details are in OWNER_RESULT_QC_V1.md.
